title_en: Technology and Engineering (10/20): Testing a Drone in an Open Field
note_en: 随着 (suízhe) "along with, as" ties one change to another and usually opens the sentence, followed by a noun phrase rather than a full clause: 随着遥控器的操作，无人机慢慢升到了空中 "As the remote control was worked, the drone slowly rose into the air." English needs a whole clause after "as," but Chinese packs it into a noun phrase with 的.
